title: Survey Insights on M365 Copilot Adoption

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through qualitative thematic analysis of post-trial survey responses, where users reported 'Anglo-centric bias' due to Copilot's transcription inaccuracies when handling multicultural contexts and diverse accents.
Measured via self-reported user concerns in a post-trial survey, capturing participants' apprehensions regarding unaddressed biases and a lack of transparency in the AI's training data.
